questionReviews.reasoningVerified: The recurrence difference is geometric, which supplies a closed formula and a justified limit; posterior conditioning is on an alert, not merely a defect.

questionReviews.thinking: Derives mass balance, identifies conserved exchange cancellation, solves a real-eigenvalue system, and separates numerical feasibility from accuracy.

questionReviews.reasoningVerified: x exceeds y for all finite nonnegative time; only x determines safety. General exchange cancels in the total. h<=2 preserves order and positive update coefficients; h>2 reverses any strictly positive difference.

questionReviews.reasoningVerified: For A>4 the derivative sign reduces to arcsin(c)-c/sqrt(1-c^2)<0, since the difference is zero at c=0 and has negative derivative thereafter. Below4 useful power rises. Thus80W at A4 is the global maximum, also satisfying the duty constraint.
